name: skautik/sdk
description: The Skautik partner API.  Every endpoint is authenticated by an API key and gated on a per-resource scope, so a key issued for market analysis cannot read anyone's enquiries and a read-only key cannot withdraw a listing.  Responses are enveloped: the payload is under `data`, and anything about the response rather than the resource is under `meta`. Failures are RFC 9457 problem documents carrying a stable `code` to branch on.  Writes accept an `Idempotency-Key`, and replaying one returns the original response rather than repeating the work.  This document is generated from the API's own route tree, so an endpoint that appears here exists and one that exists appears here.
